Product introduction

An oil-immersed transformer for rectifier systems at 35 kV and below. It supplies AC power to external thyristor or diode rectifiers, which convert that power to DC for industrial processes.

Configuration options

Rectifier load
Match the winding voltage and current to the rectifier duty and harmonic loading.
Winding connections
The illustrated ZS-8000/10-0.66 uses a Dy11d0 connection and dual 0.66 kV secondary windings.
Cooling and protection
The oil-immersed arrangement uses ONAN cooling, with an earthed screen between HV and LV windings.

Project applications

Industrial DC power

Rectifier systems serve electrolysis, traction, motor drives and other industrial processes that convert grid AC power to DC.
